messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "give once weekly at any time of day, with or without meals"
set: ["give once weekly at any time of day, with or without meals", "can be given with or without meals at any time of the day", "administer once weekly on the same day each week at any time of the day with or without meals", "injected under the skin once per week at any time of the day with or without food", "can be taken at any time of day", "once weekly", "take once daily with or without food", "taken once daily with or without food", "with or without food", "take with or without food", "can be taken any time of the day but take at the same time each day", "take once a day in the morning, with or without food", "do not give to child without medical advice", "take with food at the same time each day", "can be taken with or without food", "initiate Wegovy injection with a dose of 0.25 mg injected subcutaneously once weekly"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
